passages.text: For the choirmaster. Of David. To bring remembrance.
passages.sermon: David wrote this psalm.\r\nHe wrote it for the choirmaster.\r\nHe wrote it to help people remember.

passages.text: Make haste, O God, to deliver me! Hurry, O LORD, to help me!
passages.sermon:
David wrote this psalm.
He wrote it for the choirmaster.
He wrote it to bring remembrance.
David speaks to God.
David asks God to deliver him quickly.
David calls to the LORD for help.
David asks the LORD to hurry to help him.
passages.original: לַ֝מְנַצֵּ֗חַ לְדָוִ֥ד לְהַזְכִּֽיר׃ אֱלֹהִ֥ים לְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְעֶזְרָ֥תִי חֽוּשָֽׁה׃

passages.text: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.
passages.sermon:
David speaks to God.
David asks God to act.
Some people seek David’s life.
May these people feel shame.
May these people be confused.
Some people want to harm David.
May these people turn back.
May these people be humiliated.
passages.original: יֵבֹ֣שׁוּ וְיַחְפְּרוּ֮ מְבַקְשֵׁ֪י נַ֫פְשִׁ֥י יִסֹּ֣גוּ אָ֭חוֹר וְיִכָּלְמ֑וּ חֲ֝פֵצֵ֗י רָעָתִֽי׃

passages.text: May those who say, “Aha, aha!” retreat because of their shame.
passages.sermon:
Some people mock me.
They say, “Aha, aha!”
They try to shame me.
May these people feel ashamed.
May they turn back because of their shame.
passages.original: יָ֭שׁוּבוּ עַל־ עֵ֣קֶב בָּשְׁתָּ֑ם הָ֝אֹמְרִ֗ים הֶ֘אָ֥ח׀ הֶאָֽח׃

passages.text: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “Let God be magnified!”
passages.sermon:
All people who seek God should rejoice in God.
All people who seek God should be glad in God.
People who love God's salvation should always say this.
They should say, "Let God be magnified."
God saves His people.
God is worthy of praise.
passages.original: יָ֘שִׂ֤ישׂוּ וְיִשְׂמְח֨וּ׀ בְּךָ֗ כָּֽל־ מְבַ֫קְשֶׁ֥יךָ וְיֹאמְר֣וּ תָ֭מִיד יִגְדַּ֣ל אֱלֹהִ֑ים אֹ֝הֲבֵ֗י יְשׁוּעָתֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: But I am poor and needy; hurry to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.
passages.sermon:
I am poor.
I am needy.
God, come quickly to me.
You are my help.
You are my deliverer.
LORD, do not delay.
passages.original: וַאֲנִ֤י׀ עָנִ֣י וְאֶבְיוֹן֮ אֱלֹהִ֪ים חֽוּשָׁ֫ה־ לִּ֥י עֶזְרִ֣י וּמְפַלְטִ֣י אַ֑תָּה יְ֝הוָ֗ה אַל־ תְּאַחַֽר׃
